int_name: FOX ST & W HUNTING PARK AVE

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and marked crosswalks on one side. However, the large scale of the intersection and the presence of a heavy utility vehicle create significant sightline obstructions and long crossing distances for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A large utility truck is positioned in the intersection, significantly blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing faded markings to continental or ladder style to increase visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines by moving pedestrians further into the street before they cross.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with multiple travel lanes and faded crosswalk markings, which increases pedestrian exposure. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals and poor pavement condition detract from the overall safety of the environment.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings across the side street are significantly worn, reducing visibility for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the side street

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the crossing area presents a potential trip hazard.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane main road requires a long unprotected crossing, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental-style high-visibility markings to all legs of the intersection to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and reduce uncertainty.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including a wide sidewalk, a marked crosswalk, and a curb ramp with tactile paving. While a pedestrian signal and traffic light are present, the environment lacks traffic calming features like curb extensions or street trees to buffer pedestrians from the roadway.

hazards.name: Unprotected corner
hazards.description: The corner lacks physical barriers like bollards or street furniture to protect pedestrians from potential vehicle incursions.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the foreground

hazards.name: Standard crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The parallel line markings are less visible to approaching drivers than high-visibility continental markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extension
interventions.description: Install a bulb-out to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing parallel markings to a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the street while improving the pedestrian experience.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane intersection with a marked continental crosswalk and signal control. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of a median refuge increase risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear within the crosswalk area could present a tripping hazard or reduce the effectiveness of the markings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Crosswalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repave and restripe the crosswalk to ensure a smooth walking surface and maximum visibility for approaching drivers.
